snippet.title: ZOMVAC – Terrifying New Vacuum Chase & Jump Scare Gameplay
snippet.description:
The haunted hotel just got scarier… In this early build of ZOMVAC, we’ve added a new vacuum chase mechanic that triggers when you break objects or mess with the wrong things. Push it too far, and you’ll unleash a terrifying jump scare that will keep you on edge.

This is just a taste of what’s coming in the full game — expect even more horrifying encounters and creepy hotel secrets.

💀 Wishlist ZOMVAC on Steam:
Prototype Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853050/Zomvac_Prototype_Demo/
Full Game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845480/Zomvac/
